Which shortwave stations broadcast in French?

In the B-26 schedule, 25 stations broadcast in French. The most heavily scheduled include Radio France International, Voice of Korea, China Radio International, Radio Romania International.

What frequencies are used for shortwave broadcasts in French?

The most-used frequencies are 9790, 11700, 15300, 7220, 17850 kHz. Which one is best depends on the time of day, the season and your location.

How can I listen without a shortwave radio?

Use a free WebSDR or KiwiSDR receiver in your browser. Our Listen Online page links to receivers and explains how to tune. Schedules are in UTC, so convert to your local time first.
